Important.effect: Worker withdraws public generated files to the epoch-private unconfirmed area and writes an explicit rejected-preview record, but both immediate exception cleanup and poll finally find no active job/open attempt/unreleased lease. They return without terminalizing the operational row or correcting persisted positive job/attempt/event/artifact metadata. SQL/API truth remains SUCCEEDED with paths to withdrawn files despite a rejected final handshake. This is not authority revival, but it exposes a positive terminal publication inconsistent with the required successful confirmation and natural public evidence.
